drafts.to: City Real Estate, City of Pittsburgh
drafts.subject: Inquiry about 324 Curtin Ave
drafts.text: Dear City Real Estate, City of Pittsburgh, This is an inquiry, not an offer, regarding the City-owned vacant lot at 324 Curtin Ave in the Beltzhoover neighbourhood. The zoning district is R2-H and the City sale status is Available for Sale as of 2016-11-17. Could you please provide information about the price and the process for potentially buying this lot for a small home? Sincerely, A 24×100 user

drafts.to: City Real Estate, City of Pittsburgh
drafts.subject: Inquiry about 503 Climax St vacant lot
drafts.text: Dear City Real Estate, I am writing to inquire about the City-owned vacant lot at 503 Climax St in the Beltzhoover neighbourhood, which has a zoning district of R2-H and a City sale status of Available for Sale as of 2026-08-05. Please note that this is an inquiry, not an offer. I am interested in buying this lot for a small home and would like to know the price and the process. Sincerely, A 24×100 user
